events.evidence: The Ukrainian government and opposition agree to form a unity government and to hold early elections
Twenty-two-year-old Venezuelan beauty queen Génesis Carmona is shot in the head and killed while participating in a student protest against Nicolás Maduro's socialist government
The President of the United States, Barack Obama, meets with the Dalai Lama despite warnings from China to cancel the meeting

label.note: Ukraine de-escalation offset by Venezuela unrest and China-US friction over Dalai Lama meeting.
